title: Releases
lede: Every merged change that affects users carries a changeset. Releases are cut from `main` by a workflow, and every `@pyreon/*` package ships at the same version.

items.title: A change lands with a changeset
items.text: Each pull request that changes a published package adds a changeset (`bun changeset`) describing the change for users. While Pyreon is `0.x`, a changeset is `minor` or `patch`, never `major`; a breaking change is written as `minor` and called out in the prose.

items.title: Changesets collects them
items.text: On every push to `main`, the release workflow gathers the unreleased changesets into one "Version Packages" pull request, with the version bumps and changelog entries.

items.title: Merging it publishes
items.text: When that pull request merges, every package is published to npm with provenance, at one shared version, and GitHub releases are created.

items.title: You align with one command
items.text: `pyreon upgrade` aligns your `@pyreon/*` versions and runs the codemods for each release it crosses. It is a dry run until you pass `--write`.

items.label: Per-package CHANGELOG.md
items.text: Each package keeps its own `CHANGELOG.md`, with every entry linked to its pull request.

items.label: GitHub releases
items.text: A release for each published package.

items.label: MCP `get_changelog`
items.text: Lets your AI assistant read what changed between your version and the latest.

items.label: Blog
items.text: The stories behind the bigger changes. RSS at `/blog/rss.xml`.

sections.title: New on main, shipping in the next release
sections.text: Merged and unreleased. Each item is on `main` today and goes out with the next release.

items.title: More TypeScript compiles to iOS and Android
items.text: `effect()` in a component body, timers, `Date`, TypeScript enums, module-scope signals, `throw` / `try` / `catch`, `JSON.parse` and a `@pyreon/validate` schema's `.parse(x)` now lower to SwiftUI and Compose. The native targets remain experimental.

items.title: `<Select>` and date/time `<Field>`
items.text: `<Select>` uses each platform's own picker; `<Field kind="date" | "time" | "datetime">` with `min` / `max` opens the native date and time pickers.

items.title: `queryOptions` in `@pyreon/query`
items.text: `queryOptions`, `infiniteQueryOptions` and `mutationOptions`: declare a query once, reuse it in hooks and the client, and `client.getQueryData(opts.queryKey)` is typed without a generic.

items.title: Head tags no longer duplicate on hydration
items.text: A server-rendered page keeps exactly one copy of each `<meta>`, `<link>` and JSON-LD tag.

items.title: `mode: 'auto'` prerenders inferred-SSG routes
items.text: In a build that also has SSR routes, pages inferred as SSG are now prerendered. `mode: 'auto'` stays experimental.

items.title: Hydration-stable `createUniqueId()`
items.text: Ids in server HTML now match the hydrated component's (a per-request counter on the server, one namespace per island).

items.title: `@pyreon/validate/mini`
items.text: Ships without the runtime JIT: a 4-field object schema is 5.2 KB gzip through `mini` against 13.8 KB through the main entry (author-measured). `enableJit()` from `@pyreon/validate/jit` restores the JIT.

items.title: Scheduled content in `@pyreon/zero-content`
items.text: `publishDate: 'date'` plus `unpublished: 'omit'` keeps future-dated entries out of a production build until their date; `PYREON_CONTENT_NOW=<date>` previews the site as it will look then.

items.title: Security fixes
items.text: `@pyreon/zero` takes the request origin from `Host` for its server-action origin check, and no longer serves build internals; `@pyreon/mcp` and `@pyreon/lathe` validate tool arguments before they reach `git` or the filesystem; native `<WebView>` scopes its bridge to the loaded page's origin.

sections.text: Breaking change in the next release: `@pyreon/store`'s `subscribe` callback now receives the state as `mutation.state`, and the old second `state` argument is gone. Update `subscribe((mutation, state) => …)` to read `mutation.state`.

end.title: Every change has a changeset. Every changeset has a line in a changelog.

sources.claim: Changesets flow: Version Packages PR, publish with provenance on merge, GitHub release
No major changesets in 0.x; CI guard and release-time cap
pyreon upgrade aligns, codemods only with --write
